text: I am not one to leave a bad review but oh my god. I went in today, I never judge the rubbish or inattentive staff because I understand they are so busy and understaffed but I ordered a small frozen Coke Zero sugar as a mid work day pick me up. I saw the guy had just overfilled a regular one and instead of making me a new one he poured the regular frozen coke into my zero sugar cup and gave me a full sugar. This wouldn’t be the end of the world if I wasn’t diabetic! I felt so nauseous and sick, had to give it to my coworker because even the sip I had messed with my blood sugar so much and make me feel so faint. I had asked him when recieving my coke because I saw he gave me the wrong thing if it had no sugar and he lied to my face. I wanna give the benefit of the doubt but it’s pretty shocking, you never know who you’re serving and it’s really important to make sure to not lie to your customers.
author: Arlo McLean

text: Went into dine in ! Had to use the toilet 1st the womans  , I don't think I've ever  seen a filthier  toilet block absolutely  disgusting , human excrement on toilet seats , dirty soiled toilet paper littering the cubicles  , hand basin was so filthy I didn't even want to wash my hands  in it.  The dinning area  was the most dirtiest  dinning area I've ever seen ! Rubbish bins overflowing onto the floors , food splattering white tile walls .  I decided I wouldn't  risk my health by eating there , I am considering a complaint  to the health department  I am that concerned about how disgustingly dirty  that McDonalds is ! Infact it has put me off at this stage eating McDonalds again .
author: Kathryn Franklin

text: WHAT ARE YOU DOING MCDONALD'S LAMBERT QUAY????? This place is absolutely disgusting and I'm surprised the health inspector hasn't shut this place down!!!! Firstly, the bins are overflowing with rubbish!! There is rubbish all over the floor, spilled cups with softdrink all over the floor and  tables are absolutely filthy!! The toilets......OMG, don't get me started on the toilets!!! They smell like someone died in there!!! The soap dispenser is missing the lid and there's toilets paper all through it. There's human waste all over the toilet seat and floor!!!! How is this business allowed to stay open????? I'd give it 0 stars if I could!!!
author: Logan Ingham

text:
By far the worst state I have ever seen a McDonald’s in. Thursday evening, rubbish bins overflowing and all over the floors. The kitchen was worse. Chips, cups all sorted of rubbish under every bench or counter in the kitchen, spilt food and icecream from dispensers. You could tell the place had not been tidied let alone cleaned in a long time.
Was not busy a staff standing round.

Wouldn’t recommend, wouldn’t be back
author: Tane Thomas-Mckinley

text: Even though it was quiet when we ordered our food we still had to wait awhile for our order. It certainly wasn't hot, the burgers were average & the mocha had no flavour. It wasn't until I was looking for a seat to have my meal that I realised how dirty the place was !! All the tables needed to be wiped clean, rubbish on the floor, tables & overflowing in the rubbish bins. You can choose more wisely than I did !!
author: Angela T

text: This is the worst McDonald's that I have ever been to.  They were supposed to open at 6:30 so at 6:35 we started to try and get someone's attention.  Finally opened at 6:40 and the manager actually threatened us because of our commotion and he refused to serve us.  I'm from the U.S. and if this happened there, that manager would have been fired!
author: Alan M

text:
Place was dirty.  Employees were super rude.  Food was as expected ... but you have to wonder as dirty as this place was.

Wish I'd read the dozens of horrible reviews over the past year.  It's clear to me that McDonald's staff don't care about providing good service and that no one is enforcing company standards.  Will go elsewhere next time
author: Jeff R

text: Don’t count on this location to open on time for an early breakfast. Their hours show 0630 opening every day, which is earlier than anything else in the area, but a gentleman came downstairs at 0635 to let me know they wouldn’t open until 0715. He was polite but the failure to open screwed up our already limited breakfast options.
author: Chris Mann

text: I order via door dash and most of the time my order is missing either Fries or Sweet & Sour Sauce and Straws for the drinks very disappointing that this keeps happening orders should be treated seriously even if it’s just a small mishap like forgetting sauce or the fries I paid $50 and feel ripped off !
author: Vstar

text: Female toilets were disgusting and an embarrassment to the city. Mouldy, dirty, in need of repair and renovations, unhygienic (could see pink mould in hand basin, puddles in the toilet cubicle. We could not stay and receive food from a food outlet with this level of lack of care and filth of the toilet.

text: Music was very loud. I asked one of the staff if it could be turned down, but it never was. The fries were not very nice; it was like the oil needed to be changed. The rubbish bins were full, and I couldn't put our rubbish in. Very sad, and the place never gets any better each time I have been there.

text: Dirty, slow, staff over worked, long wait times, no one cares, McDonald's nz needs to come check this store out secretly, it is disgusting, the toilet does don't lock, there is food debre everywhere, the place is full of angry customers, I will go to other stores if I can.

text: very slow service i was waiting for 20 minutes, there were barely any people in there so i don't know what the hold up was. all the employees were just talking amongst themselves and were very rude. will not be coming again. appalling behaviour from this establishment.

text: By far the most disgusting Mc Donalds I've ever been to. Almost all the tables had trash and/or food scraps on them, the floor was very dirty and sticky, and the bins were overflowing. Let's hope the hygiene standards aren't the same in the kitchen.
